name: hackops-academy/AstralOSINT
description: AstraOSINT is a professional-grade, web-based Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) tool designed for researchers, OSINT analysts, and hobbyists. It provides a centralized interface for satellite imagery analysis, point-of-interest tracking, and tactical route planning.
score_rationale: Web-based GEOINT tool designed for analysts and hobbyists, directly aligned to the subdomain.
summary: Web-based GEOINT tool for imagery analysis, tracking, and route planning.
